scope: Formal paired 500K study of the own-target progress potential versus the unchanged mass-weighted potential, both from EXP35 unit_speed 500K. Milestone checkpoints selected on disjoint selection layouts (950000000), reported on the 100 development layouts.
authorization: Prepared autonomously (code, tests, certificates, 16K preflight). The 500K launch requires explicit user approval.
transition_unit: one environment control step, not individual robot samples
comparability: Arms share parents, PPO settings, training stream 1900000000, validation layouts 940000000-940000099 and every physics field except progress_potential (asserted by the driver). Shaping arithmetic of the control potential is unchanged (tests/test_mca_assigned_potential.py).
task_limit: Controlled in-vitro goal-conditioned ideal-actuator simulation with perfect state. All object positions randomized on fixed MCA anatomy. Soft overlap costs, not hard collision physics. Diagnostic clearance feasibility is not collision-free policy performance or hardware verification.
dashboard_message: EXP39 ASSIGNED 500K 配对：自身目标势函数。
study_stage: Formal 500K paired study; validation split for selection, sealed test (500 layouts) for the reported result.

checkpoint_selection.rule: Pick the milestone with the highest complete-clearance rate on the 200 registered validation layouts (configs/evaluation_splits.json); ties go to the earlier milestone. The parent (0 steps) is a candidate.

sealed_test.candidates: one selected checkpoint per arm and seed (6); the EXP35 parent is tested once under study BASELINE_EXP35
sealed_test.report: Final claims use only sealed-test results; 940000000-940000099 is diagnostic only.
